spans.s:
Uddhi^1 denotes some part of a chariot, probably the seat,^2
but, according to Roth,^3 the frame resting on the axle.
1) Av. viii. 8, 22; Śatapatha Brāh-
maṇa, xii. 2, 2, 2; Aitareya Āraṇyaka,
ii. 3, 8.
2) So Whitney's Translation of the
Atharvaveda, 506; Eggeling, Sacred
Books of the East, 44, 149.
3) St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
